evaluation.average_definition: mean of (SA + PC) / 2; custom summary, not official Joint Score
evaluation.missing_policy: no final comparison unless every selected case has both valid SA and PC scores

scope: Fixed development subset: VideoPhy2 captions adapted to shared-first-image I2V; not official T2V leaderboard
selection: Every fifth case in the existing 60-case manifest, selected before candidate generation/scoring.
conditioning: Native T5 text only; latent C disabled
generation_caption: original caption plus frozen-Qwen visible process detail
rewrite_instruction: The image is the starting frame of a requested video. Write only two or three short sentences of additional VISIBLE process detail to append after the original request. Preserve the exact requested action, participants, object counts, materials, direction, and outcome, including any requested mistake, failure or unusual event. Explain the visible trigger or contact, the resulting change, and how that change continues or ends. For fluids, smoke, waves, bending or unfolding, describe the relevant visible process instead of treating everything as rigid objects. Ground starting facts in the image; the requested future is a requirement, not something already observed. Do not invent new people, tools, contacts or completed outcomes. Do not replace a requested failure with successful performance. Avoid equations, numeric forces, trajectories, timestamps, abstract law names, cinematic embellishments, camera instructions and general warnings. Use at most 75 English words. Output only the additional description, without headings, analysis or a restatement of the task. If a detail is uncertain, omit it.
